title: Implement IPFS block write and CID recording on POST
description:
Write the signed article bytes to IPFS as a raw block, obtain the CID. Insert (message_id, cid) into the Message-ID→CID map. If the IPFS write fails, return 441 without adding to the log. Artifact: reader/src/post/ipfs_write.rs.

Acceptance:
- IPFS block write returns a stable CID for identical article bytes
- CID is recorded in SQLite before log append begins
- IPFS write failure returns 441; no partial state (CID must be in map before log append)
- Integration test: POST article, verify CID retrievable via ipfs block get
